title: Neural network and NSGA-II optimize liquid culture medium for Morchella mycelium
summary: A multilayer perceptron trained on a 27-run full factorial design (malt extract, yeast extract, inorganic salt) reproduced mycelial dry weight with R2 = 0.9648 and was coupled with NSGA-II to trade off biomass against medium cost. The maximum predicted dry weight was 14.20 g/L, 20.44% above the base medium. Three Pareto solutions were validated in shake flasks with relative errors of 1.69%, 0.65% and 0.84%. Only biomass was quantified, and this is a preprint.
ai_technology: 3-5-1 multilayer perceptron (Levenberg-Marquardt) as surrogate model coupled with NSGA-II multi-objective optimization of medium yield and cost

evidence.tested: Three Pareto-optimal media tested in shake flasks; relative errors 1.69%, 0.65%, 0.84% versus predictions.
evidence.unknown: Effect on any metabolite or scale-up performance; small 27-run dataset; preprint; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Multilayer perceptron surrogate model with NSGA-II multi-objective optimization of culture medium
